inputs.name: quadratic-bspline-1d-canonical
inputs.base_node_convention: base = floor(p + 0.5) - 1; particle interacts with base, base+1, base+2

independent_reference.source: (1) Hand-derivation in tools/testkit/golden/derivations/mls-mpm-quadratic-bspline.md § 2: every sample value substituted directly from the piecewise formula N(x) = 3/4 - x^2 for |x|<1/2 / (1/2)(3/2-|x|)^2 for 1/2<=|x|<3/2. (2) Hu, Y. et al. (2018), 'A Moving Least Squares Material Point Method...', ACM TOG 37 (4), DOI 10.1145/3197517.3201293, § 3 + the 88-line reference (mls-mpm88.cpp) — same formula, same numerical values. (3) Steffen, M., Kirby, R. M. & Berzins, M. (2008), 'Analysis and reduction of quadrature errors in the material point method (MPM)', IJNME 76 (6), 922-948, DOI 10.1002/nme.2360, § 3 Eq. (15) — quadratic B-spline MPM analysis with identical formula. (4) Python re-derivation by tools/testkit/golden/generator/mls_mpm_quadratic_bspline.py.
independent_reference.derived_by: hand-derivation cross-checked against Hu 2018 88-line reference, Steffen-Kirby-Berzins 2008 Eq. (15), and Python re-derivation.
